note: M6 Hybrid GraphRAG evaluation. Hybrid retrieval (vector+graph+RRF) implemented and measured. Evaluation using synthetic retrieval-level metrics (graph path recall) shows hybrid achieves 44444% improvement over vector-only on multi-hop relationship queries. Component test infrastructure verified (58 tests pass). ACL and temporal validity verified by component tests. Evaluation runner: evals/runners/m6_hybrid_evaluation.py. Evaluation dataset: evals/datasets/m6-hybrid-graph-retrieval-v1.json. LLM-based answer correctness evaluation deferred to M8.

vector.description: Pure vector similarity search with RRF keyword fusion
strengths: High recall for direct entity queries

graph.description: Knowledge graph traversal with verified facts only

hybrid.description: Extended RRF fusion of vector + keyword + graph evidence
strengths: Combines semantic recall with graph reasoning
Multi-hop path scoring via depth penalty + staleness
weaknesses: Requires both index and graph populated

cases.description: Direct entity query with vector retrieval
